title: Agent-UCT: Upper Confidence Bounds Applied to Trees for Cost-Aware Agentic Workflow Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2607.24162v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Workflow search pays for complete quality observations, whose execution cost changes as reusable prefixes accumulate. AgentUCT uses an economic model of the remaining evaluation cost to guide UCT selection while backing up raw quality. Query-prefix accounting connects the search decisions to reusable execution state. For finite fixed-reward trees with bounded adaptive cold-cost estimates and successful persistent caching, we prove an $O(\log T)$ bound on cumulative quality regret over $T$ complete evaluations. Across five paired seeds, AgentUCT achieves 69.57% test F1 versus 68.01% for UCT at a 32M weighted-token budget on a retrospective HotpotQA panel. On GSM8K, it reaches 93.07% mean accuracy at the first budget, compared with 92.60% for UCT and 91.60% for AFlow. Single-factor RAG controls show that online prices and historical continuations improve the selected workflows at equal retained evaluation counts.

translated_title: Agent-UCT：将置信上界应用于树搜索以实现成本感知的智能体工作流优化
translated_abstract: 工作流搜索需要为完整的质量观测付费，而其执行成本会随着可复用前缀的积累而发生变化。AgentUCT 使用一个关于剩余评估成本的经济模型来引导 UCT 的选择，同时回传原始质量值。查询前缀核算将搜索决策与可复用的执行状态联系起来。对于具有有界自适应冷启动成本估计和成功持久化缓存的有限固定奖励树，我们证明了在 T 次完整评估中累积质量遗憾的 O(log T) 上界。在五个配对随机种子上，AgentUCT 在回顾性 HotpotQA 面板上以 32M 加权令牌预算实现了 69.57% 的测试 F1，而 UCT 为 68.01%。在 GSM8K 上，它在第一个预算下达到 93.07% 的平均准确率，相比之下 UCT 为 92.60%，AFlow 为 91.60%。单因素 RAG 对照实验表明，在相同的保留评估次数下，在线价格和历史延续信息能够改进所选工作流的表现。
tldr: AgentUCT 通过对剩余评估成本进行经济建模来引导 UCT 树搜索，实现了成本感知的智能体工作流优化，证明了 O(log T) 的累积质量遗憾理论界，并在 HotpotQA 和 GSM8K 上优于标准 UCT 和 AFlow。
en_tdlr: AgentUCT guides UCT tree search with an economic model of remaining evaluation cost to achieve cost-aware agentic workflow optimization, proving an O(log T) cumulative quality regret bound and outperforming standard UCT and AFlow on HotpotQA and GSM8K.
